freight-invoice.schemaFieldList:
Buyer: Name, Address, City, Postal Code, Country, Country Code
Seller: Name, Address, City, Postal Code, Country, Country Code, VAT No, Registration No
Invoice Details: Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Due Date, Payment Terms, Currency Code, Net Amount, Total Tax, Total Amount
Payment Details: Payment Details Description
Freight Shipments: Shipment Reference, Job Number, Mode Of Transport, Service Level, Carrier Name, Carrier Code, Booking Number, Master Bill Of Lading, House Bill Of Lading, Vessel Name, Voyage Number, Ship From, Ship To, Origin Location, Departure Location, Origin Country Code, Departure Date, Destination Location, Arrival Location, Destination Country Code, Arrival Date, Incoterms, Customer Reference, Shipper Reference, Customs Reference, Packages, Weight, Chargeable Weight, Volume, Equipment Type, Containers, Shipment Total, Line Charges
Containers: Container ID, Equipment Type
Charges: Charge Group, Charge Code, Description, Shipment Reference, Job Number, Currency, Amount, Rate, VAT Rate, VAT Amount, PrepaidOrCollect
Payment Methods: payment_method, account_no, BIC_or_Swift_code, Payment Reference
Tax: tax_code, tax_total, rate
Line Charges (nested): Charge Group, Charge Code, Description, Currency, Amount, Rate, VAT Rate, VAT Amount, PrepaidOrCollect
Ship From (nested): Company Name, Street Address, Postal Code, City, Country
Ship To (nested): Company Name, Street Address, Postal Code, City, Country
Departure Location (nested): Postal Code, City, IATA Code, UNLOC Code
Arrival Location (nested): Postal Code, City, IATA Code, UNLOC Code
"Invoice Charges" in the returned document = the table "Charges" here; use "Charges" as the items name
"Invoice Containers" in the returned document = the table "Containers" here; use "Containers" as the items name
"Line Containers" in the returned document = the table "Freight Shipments.Containers" here; use "Freight Shipments.Containers" as the items name
